notes: Captured from a live application by the user during manual testing. No personal data.

Ashby renders the whole application WITHOUT a <form> element — the capture reports formDetected: false. Nothing in the fill path requires one, but it rules out any future selector that assumes a form wrapper.

Ashby puts a radio group's question in a <label> inside the <fieldset> rather than in a <legend>. Until that was handled, every radio group on every Ashby form was skipped — including gender and CEFR language level.
Ashby's yes/no questions point label[for] at the field's NAME rather than its id, which the browser does not treat as an association, so el.labels is empty and the field looked unlabelled.
Most ids are per-posting UUIDs, so a taught field mapping will not transfer between Ashby postings.

mustNotMatchWhy.23ded4a0-4c94-43a6-bb23-cb5bd93a786a: "Be aware, this is a full-time internship role. Does this work for you?" is a question only the applicant can answer.
